security.title: Frontend security
security.body: JWT authentication and role-based access control on the Evaria - Cycles & Wellness patient and admin platform, XSS/CSRF-aware data handling, and secure upload flows for photograph, signature and document steps on the UPSC portal.
security.footnote: Implementation specifics are deliberately not published.

testing.title: Testing & quality
testing.body: Jest and React Testing Library, weighted toward the paths where failure costs the most — demonstrated on the PVR INOX booking and payment flows, with component tests guarding reusable UI against regressions.

ai.title: AI-assisted, engineer-reviewed
ai.body: AI-assisted development is part of the workflow at Appinventiv, but every generated change goes through the same review bar as hand-written code before it merges — see Experience for how that plays out day to day.
